05/20.04.2023: Heard the parties.

The applicant, who is in custody since 07.10.2022, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with POCSO Case No.91 of 2022 arising out of Radhanagar P.S. Case No.200 of 2022 registered for the offence under Section 376 IPC and Section 4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of Special Judge, POCSO Act, Rajmahal.
The applicant is an accused of committing rape upon a girl below the age of 15 years.
It has been submitted by the counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence has been claimed and participation in the trial has been assured.
It has been submitted that there is family dispute between the parties and as such, the applicant has falsely been implicated in this case.
On the above facts, prayer for bail has been made.
On the other hand, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail and it has been submitted that there is material evidence to corroborate the incident.
Considering the above facts, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant (s) on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the applicant(s) stands rejected.
